subject: Deflaking tests to remove chance of false positives causing tests to fail (#34)
reason: The change modifies only test code: the Rust unit-test helper inside `mod tests` in src/bloom/utils.rs and the Python integration tests under tests/, relaxing assertions so probabilistic bloom-filter false positives don't fail CI. No shipped module code (command handling, replies, persistence, scaling) changes, so there is no runtime behaviour to test and no scenario is needed.
